title: Schedule your foley recording session (or delegate it)
question: You committed to personally recording the bespoke sound effects — chiefly the watering sound, because after six rejected takes it's established that no usable free recording exists anywhere of a watering can's rose head sprinkling onto soil. It has to be made. Recording it yourself also gives the cleanest possible ownership: no third-party license to ever track. The shipped sounds are complete and legal, so nothing blocks on this — it's purely waiting on the audio direction sign-off and your calendar.
why_now: It's the only item in the queue assigned to *you* as the doer, and unowned calendar items rot. One decision closes it: when, or whether to hand it off.

options.label: Schedule it after the audio direction is approved
options.detail: Pick a weekend; the session targets the approved aesthetic. Pairs naturally with ruling the audio direction card above.

options.label: Delegate to the audio role
options.detail: Give up the self-recorded provenance; someone else sources or records the takes.

options.label: Park it explicitly
options.detail: Acknowledge it's post-release polish and take it off the active queue.
